```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# No row-level data. Tables, figures, and in-text numbers come from
# approved result files (01-data/metadata or 05-outputs) and from
# figures already written to 05-outputs/figures.

pkgs <- c("here", "jsonlite", "dplyr", "flextable", "knitr")
missing <- setdiff(pkgs, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing)) {
  stop(
    "Missing packages: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
    "\nInstall them and render again."
  )
}
invisible(lapply(pkgs, require, character.only = TRUE))

helpers <- here::here("manuscript/helpers.R")
if (!file.exists(helpers)) {
  helpers <- "helpers.R"
}
source(helpers)
```
